{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:34:47.119
    | text      = Beyond that, I want to say one thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:34:49.119
    | text      = And that Alex is a country poser.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:34:52.479
    | text      = He's trying to sell this knife by saying you can use it to skin a buck and run a trot line.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:34:56.319
    | text      = But a trot line is a fishing setup that mostly involves tying knots.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:00.239
    | text      = He just says those two examples whenever he wants to sound like he's a hail Billy because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:04.479
    | text      = they're from Hank Williams Jr's song, a country boy can survive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:08.720
    | text      = This is a guy who's wearing an outfit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:12.000
    | text      = He's a poser.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:12.800
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:13.920
    | text      = It would be like me trying to say that I grew up on a farm because I sang Toby Keith at
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:18.319
    | text      = karaoke.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:19.039
    | text      = This is bullshit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:22.399
    | text      = You know, it is just one of those like if something works, people keep doing it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:28.720
    | text      = When you see people doing something, they're doing it because it makes sense to them because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:33.039
    | text      = it works over time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:34.720
    | text      = Why wouldn't you pose?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:36.319
    | text      = Everything he does is a pose.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:37.840
    | text      = And it's always been more successful than trying to be himself because he's a piece
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:41.840
    | text      = of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:43.600
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:45.279
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:46.399
    | text      = So there's more to this episode, but I thought that this would be a good breaking off point
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:51.760
    | text      = because Alex seems to be in good spirits.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:54.399
    | text      = Yeah, absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:55.439
    | text      = Generally speaking, he's a little bit pissed off that Trump's so dumb he's chewing his
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:58.560
    | text      = foot off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:58.960
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:35:59.439

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
